properties.description: On a registry server behind a trusted host, before each call on a design whose reasoning names a reference xref:<design>:<node>, the server reads each far node in its own design (under that design's guard alone, only if the caller may read it) and hands the readings to the call (reflow2_core::far::scoped via service::far::FarScoped). The premise then carries the far node's truth; a far proof status short of proven keeps a confirmed line here from proven; what the far node holds only under there (unverified citation, open assumption) makes the claim here conditional. A far node that is gone reads stale; a far design the caller may not read, or any server that reaches no other design, reads unreachable: unknown, never holding. Through a hub's address, propagate_from and propagate_change continue into each design of the view (hub + readable members) holding a reference to a node the walk reached, and on from there, each design entered once: the references are named in boundary_crossings with their design's prefix and each radius comes back under across_designs. Readings are per call and never stored. Engine-side (crates/reflow2-core/src/far.rs, crates/reflow2-mcp/src/service/far.rs), so a local --registry-root hub gets it as flo2.io does.
properties.name: A premise in another design reads as it reads there, and through a hub a change walk continues into the designs that cite what it reached
